ablation.name: phase4h6b_eota_swd_low_emphasis
ablation.notes: Phase 4H.6b: EOTA + alpha=0.7 + swd_low=2.0 swd_high=0.5. Emphasize low-frequency SWD (content structure) over high-frequency (texture). Hypothesis: with EOTA already controlling style, stronger low-freq SWD improves content preservation further. Tests the SWD frequency decomposition role.
